_doc: Explicit, audited exemptions to the ci_green_on_base tripwire. A PR listed here is one that REPAIRS the red base CI itself, so it cannot pass ci_green_on_base pre-merge (the classic 'fix can't self-green' deadlock). Keyed 'owner/repo#pr'. Adding an entry is a deliberate operator/caretaker act and is logged here. Removing the entry (or it never existing) restores the full block — fail-safe. The validate_tripwires check_ci_green() only honors an entry when invoked with --pr matching it.

The E2E smoke tests PRODUCTION, so this PR cannot turn the check green until it merges + Vercel redeploys -> ci_green_on_base deadlock.
